first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and previously produced strong acquisition and revenue lift. I would verify its customer-quality and retention effects, while using the onboarding evidence as the main alternative given the current completion decline. A guarded test limits discount-driven downstream value risk.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening the onboarding flow. The verified source showed higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Reject promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because its verified cohort suffered a 12% retention decline and failed to survive the first renewal cycle.
